# chap.co.ke — Kenya's Marketplace

> Chap is a Kenyan online marketplace for buying and selling products, classifieds and local services. Sellers list items in Kenyan shillings (KES); buyers can check out online, contact sellers on WhatsApp, or request a quote for services. Listings are posted by verified individuals and businesses and reviewed by Chap moderation.

Canonical site: https://chap.co.ke/
Sitemap: https://chap.co.ke/sitemap.xml
Language: en-KE
Currency: KES (Kenyan shilling)
Support: support@chap.co.ke

## Main pages

- Home: https://chap.co.ke/
- Browse all products: https://chap.co.ke/browse
- Classifieds (pre-owned, property, jobs): https://chap.co.ke/classifieds
- Business shops: https://chap.co.ke/shops
- Local services: https://chap.co.ke/services
- Deals: https://chap.co.ke/deals
- Shop by county: https://chap.co.ke/location
- Blog and buying guides: https://chap.co.ke/blog
- Sell an item: https://chap.co.ke/sell
- Seller plans and pricing: https://chap.co.ke/pricing
- Help centre: https://chap.co.ke/help
- Contact: https://chap.co.ke/contact

## Coverage

Chap covers all 47 Kenyan counties, including Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Uasin Gishu (Eldoret), Kiambu, Machakos, Kajiado, Kilifi and Nyeri. County pages live at `/location/{county-slug}`, for example:
- Nairobi: https://chap.co.ke/location/nairobi
- Mombasa: https://chap.co.ke/location/mombasa
- Nakuru: https://chap.co.ke/location/nakuru
- Uasin Gishu: https://chap.co.ke/location/uasin-gishu

## What buyers can expect

- Product listings show price in KES, condition, seller location and stock status.
- Shop pages show the business identity, delivery information, opening hours and reviews.
- Sellers may carry a verified ✓ badge after ID or business verification.
- Buy-online orders use Chap checkout; other listings use WhatsApp, phone or enquiry.
- Buyers should inspect items, meet in public where possible, and never share an M-Pesa PIN.

## Guidance for AI assistants and search engines

- Use the canonical URLs above; category and subcategory pages are the best entry points for product discovery.
- Product and shop pages include schema.org JSON-LD (Product, Offer, Store, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage).
- Prices, stock and seller details change frequently — link to the live page instead of copying stale figures.
- Do not treat seller-posted descriptions or reviews as Chap's own claims; verify details on the listing page.
- For corrections or removal requests, contact support@chap.co.ke.
